scripts.install:packages: npm install --prefix packages/model-adapters && npm install --prefix packages/agent-core
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --prefix packages/model-adapters && npm run build --prefix packages/agent-core
scripts.install:all: npm run install:packages && npm run build:packages && npm install --prefix apps/api && npm install --prefix apps/web && npm install --prefix apps/approuter
scripts.ci:install: npm ci --prefix packages/model-adapters && npm ci --prefix packages/agent-core && npm run build:packages && npm ci --prefix apps/api && npm ci --prefix apps/web && npm ci --prefix apps/approuter
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix packages/model-adapters && npm run typecheck --prefix packages/agent-core && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/api && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm test --prefix packages/model-adapters && npm test --prefix packages/agent-core && npm test --prefix apps/api && npm test --prefix apps/web
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --prefix apps/api && npm run build --prefix apps/web
